help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Answers to the questions a new member asks first.
help.q1: How do I deposit into the vault?
help.a1: Open Deposit, check the amount prefilled with the monthly contribution, then confirm with your PIN. The entry is written to the audit ledger.
help.a2: A member proposes a withdrawal. It needs 75% of the group to approve, including at least one ordinary member. Then the President records the payout.
help.a3: The rotation decides which member receives the vault each cycle. Officers can re-shuffle the order with the lottery.
help.a4: Only members of your group can see group data. The audit ledger is read-only for everyone.
help.q5: Why does it ask for my PIN again?
help.a5: Every action that moves money re-checks your PIN, even when you are already signed in.
help.q6: What happens if I forget my PIN?
help.a6: There is no way to skip the PIN check. Contact your group's officers to reset your access.
help.q7: Is my money held by Ibimina?
help.a7: No. Ibimina records what the group decides. It does not hold or transfer funds in this phase.
help.q8: How do I leave a group?
help.a8: Open Settings, then Delete account. If you are the only President, appoint another President first.
